test_simple_trainer: test a SimpleTrainer by creating a model, dataloader, and optimizer then calling train
test_reset_data_loader: test resetting a SimpleTrainer dataloader mid-training by calling reset_data_loader with a new generator
test_writer_hooks: test registering PeriodicWriter and EvalHook on a SimpleTrainer to log metrics to JSON
test_checkpoint_resume: test checkpoint save and resume with Checkpointer to restore model, optimizer, and scheduler state
test_best_checkpointer: test BestCheckpointer hook to save checkpoints only when a metric improves in max or min mode
